title: Zen Space
meta_description: an app that helps you focus and tune out life's distractions
full_description: Zen Space is an app that helps you eliminate distractions so you can focus on what matters. Deep Zen and Light Zen features are here to supercharge your productivity.In the Deep Zen space, the system automatically silences all notifications and disables all apps other than the Camera, so you can give your undivided attention to the task at hand. A Light Zen space allows you to choose the apps you need in different circumstances, so you can quickly find your zen and get on with things. You can create multiple Light Zen spaces and switch between them as necessary.We've also provided a dashboard where you can view your zen data and share your zen achievements.*Zen Space is currently available only for devices running ColorOS 13.1 or a later version.For devices that do not support Zen Space, Zen Mode (the older version of Zen Space) will be downloaded.
